answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 14419 Country: United States of America Title: Can a non-Muslim work for and/or supply products/services to the Wakf? Thank You Question: Can a non-Muslim work for and/or supply products/services to the Wakf? Thank You Answer ID: 14419 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1353/1104=D/1430) For awqaf (endowments) and related duties, a Muslim should be employed to a possible extent. If there is no Muslim available, it is lawful to employ a non-Muslim in compulsion: ولا تشترط الحریۃ والإسلام للصحۃ لما في الإسعاف: ولو کان عبدا یجوز قیاسا واستحسانا، والذي في الحکم کالعبد (الهندية 2:408) What do you mean by services? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
